summary: Components of a multi-component substrate that the template does not touch

values.dropped: only the reacted component is returned (RDKit, chematic)
values.kept: the whole input comes back as one object, spectators included (Open Babel in-place, xenosmarts)
values.kept_split: spectators kept as separate fragments; small ones may then hit the byproduct blocklist (BioTransformer)
values.kept_labels: kept, with Ambit implicit-H labels (cdk raw)
